name: vuesp.kc868-a16
summary: KinCony KC868-A16 industrial I/O controller with 16 inputs, 16 MOSFET outputs, 4 ADC, Ethernet and Modbus RTU.
description:
## Vuesp KC868-A16

Firmware 5.0.0 for the KinCony KC868-A16. Sixteen opto-isolated inputs and sixteen MOSFET outputs use PCF8574 expanders, four ADC channels are exposed in the I/O page, and Ethernet LAN8720 / Wi-Fi plus Modbus RTU are supported.

The project is based on Vuesp 5.x, uses ConfigStore, diagnostics, the current web UI and the new I/O / Modbus pages.
